description:
A bouncy block you can hit :)

Hit Me! A bouncy block you can hit :)

Commands:
  /hitme           - Spawn your bouncy block
  /stophittingme   - Despawn your bouncy block

Features:
  • Block flies when punched with, well... physics o.O
  • Particles on hit
  • Plays sound when hit
  • One block per player (MP should work, tested in LAN)
  • Invincible - only removed by command or when drowned/shot at

Perfect for:
  • Playing soccer with friends
  • Practicing your aim
  • Stress relief after mining
  • Just having fun!
  • Others, I'm not your mom!

Requires: Mineclonia, mcl_mobs
